verdict.rationale: Undermind has automation-adjacent features, such as saved-topic alerts, API batch processing and an MCP server, so asking whether those automations can be managed is a fair question. However, the evidence pack documents no way to version, review, or roll back automations. Notes and saved searches persisting across sessions is a different capability and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
